newsitem.title: USA: CCC adds HRW wheat class to Eritrea tender.
newsitem.headline: CCC adds HRW wheat class to Eritrea tender.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp expanded its original wheat tender to Eritrea to include the class of U.S. hard red winter wheat.
The tender was previously announced on September 19.
The CCC said on Tuesday it is seeking up to 35,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better hard red winter or soft red winter or soft white wheat under the export donation program to Eritrea.
Shipment is set for October 10-November 5. Offers are due by September 26.
The CCC is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
